studioDesign.basis: EBU Tech 3276 acoustic targets; near-field layout is not its 2-4m stereo-base reference layout
studioDesign.eyringNote: diffuse-field design estimate, not measured T60 or low-frequency modal prediction
studioDesign.earlyCheckNote: geometric first-order 1-8kHz screening only; excludes HRTF/directivity, higher-order overlap and desk

reference.hrirProcessing: publisher diffuse-field equalized, time-aligned and windowed; preserved as supplied
reference.dcCorrection: causal 2nd-order Butterworth 10 Hz; ISM numerical DC artifact correction, no gain normalization
reference.timing: geometric r/c plus supplied FIR/filter latency; no second 1.2m flight time added
